decision_conditions:
<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
 </ol><p>The
     proposed&nbsp;single and two storey rear extension by reason of its
     excessive depth adjacent to the shared boundary with No.34, would result
     in an unacceptable and unreasonable level of harm to the residential
     amenities of the occupiers of No.34 Eastcote Avenue. The development would
     cause significant overshadowing, loss of daylight, an increased sense of
     enclosure, and an overbearing visual impact, contrary to The NPPF (2024), Policy
     DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013),
     Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), and the provisions of the Harrow
     Residential Design Guide SPD.<o:p></o:p></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
</ol>

<ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
 </ol><p>The
     proposed development is located within surface water flood zones 3ahigh
     &amp; 3b medium. In the absence of a satisfactory Flood Risk Assessment,
     it has not been demonstrated that the proposed development would not
     exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and
     consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to National Planning Policy
     Framework (2024), Policy SI 12 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy
     CS1.U of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM9 and DM10 of the
     Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></p><ol style="margin-top:0cm" start="1" type="1">
</ol>
description: Single and two storey rear extension with external steps; external alterations (demolition of single storey rear extension)
